## Task

Task ID from `docs/TASKS.md` (for example M1.1):

## Summary

What changed and why.

## Test evidence

Commands run and their results (lint, typecheck, unit, integration, privacy).

## Privacy impact

State **none**, or describe what changes for health data, logs, events, notifications, location or retention. Anything touching `restricted/`, auth, crypto, infra or data schemas needs approval before coding.

## Checklist

- [ ] Acceptance criteria in `docs/TASKS.md` met
- [ ] Tests added; privacy test added if health data is involved
- [ ] No real personal or health data in code, tests, fixtures or seeds
- [ ] Docs and `CLAUDE.md` updated if behaviour or commands changed
